signal.description: Always the completion signal, exactly as the prompt asks you to output it when you are done.

unmet.description: The acceptance criteria you knowingly left undone, as the <unmet> line asks for. Set assessed to true once you have checked every criterion, with no items when all are met; false when you did not assess them, with no items.

assessed.description: True when you checked every acceptance criterion against the branch; false when you did not.

items.description: One item per criterion left undone; empty when every criterion is met.

who.description: person when only a person can finish it (access, a deploy, a file agents may not edit, a decision), as <unmet who="person">; agent otherwise.

text.description: One sentence naming the criterion left undone.

changelog.description: The changelog lines the <changelog> tag asks for, one per item: one or two sentences each, starting Added:, Changed: or Fixed:. Empty when the change needs no changelog line.

followups.description: The problems outside this ticket that the <followup> tag asks for, one per item, as 'title - one line of evidence'. Empty when there are none.

ungated.description: What a person should check because no gate exercises the change, as the <ungated> tag asks for, one per item. Empty when every change is exercised by a gate.
